init_process_group: initialize a distributed process group with local rank, world size, shard id, and nccl backend
all_gather_tensors: gather tensors from all processes across machines and concatenate them along dimension 0
all_reduce_tensors: reduce tensors across all processes with optional averaging by world size
all_gather_unaligned_data: gather arbitrary picklable data from all ranks using gloo backend with automatic padding
synchronize_processes: synchronize all processes with a barrier when using distributed training across multiple GPUs
